notes.title: Announcing our new game: Pythagoria The Finals
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/909710/Pythagoria_The_Finals/][h1]Wishlist Pythagoria: The Finals[/h1][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26098736/a5590c68ede4a3c3a87f5f09e675b6a23e15ae9d.png[/img]

After 9 long years, the wait is finally over! Pythagoria: The Finals is here, bringing the beloved puzzle game back with exciting new features and even more brain-teasing challenges.

We’ve kept everything that made the original Pythagoria a fan favorite — the simple yet captivating concept, the geometric elegance, and the satisfying sense of discovery — and built on it with fresh ideas to make your gameplay experience even more enjoyable.

While we don’t have a release date just yet, we need your help to bring the game to life sooner! Add Pythagoria: The Finals to your Steam wishlist today and encourage your friends to do the same. The more support we get, the sooner we can release the game and share this exciting experience with you.

In Pythagoria: The Finals, we set out to honor the spirit of mathematics, youth, Greece, and the competitive drive that made the original game so special. We also dedicate this new chapter to the memories of those who were instrumental in creating the first Pythagoria, but are no longer with us. Their contributions continue to inspire us as we bring this sequel to life.

We're planning to share more information in the coming months, so stay tuned.

For more information, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/909710/Pythagoria_The_Finals/]visit the Steam page[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/909710/Pythagoria_The_Finals/

notes.title: True or False Universe launches September 15th
notes.content:
About a year ago we've announced the new game which changed our lives. Some of you might still remember it. It was called True or False. If you were with us since the day one, you remember that on launch True or False was a free game with optional DLC. Your feeback helped us to improve the game and make True or False 2 which had over 95% positive reviews on Steam for several months after its release.

Today we're happy to announce [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/698370/True_or_False_Universe/]True or False Universe[/url], all-new free-to-play game in the series.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098736/6455ab93e037e97ee67e4be63adbe09a62f803ef.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/698370?beta=0

The best thing about True or False games is that you can learning something new by playing it while having fun. True or False Universe takes the concept further - now you will learn something new everyday.

We consulted several top experts in the field of free-to-play games, and they have contributed their ideas about how to improve player's experience. This means that the game will provide modern up-to-date free-to-play experience. 

We built True or False Universe to scale. That means that we want to support it with regular content updates after its release for some time.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/698370/True_or_False_Universe/]True or False Universe[/url] will be available on September 15th. You can add it to your wishlist now and follow it to receive future updates.

We just love to build games, and we're happy to see you having fun. Let is know what you think!

notes.content:
Hello all,

I just wanted to take a moment to congratulate you.

This is incredible for a game without a publisher to have over 100,000 players in just the ten days after the release.

Thank you very much for being a part of this. It was wonderful to meet all of you.

Best regards to Valve for their work, and also to everyone who contributed to the game in any way.

See you all soon, hope you all have a fantastic week!

notes.title: Free DLC "Owl Rescue" release date and more!
notes.content:
Hello all,

Are you ready for a new adventure?

Over last week, I've been listening closely to your feedback, and that affected the way I approach the game's forthcoming content.

Very soon the game will feature new mode called "Adventures", an individual mini-campaigns. And I'm happy to announce that the first adventure, upcoming free DLC "Owl Rescue", is scheduled to launch on September 30, 2016. 

http://store.steampowered.com//app/533870
Owl Rescue will feature 50 all-new facts with explanations and better difficulty curve, and it will be available to all players for free.

But that's not all.

For those who owns the Expansion Pack, the long wait is finally over! It took me a bit of work, and starting today contents of Expansion Pack are also available in the Campaign mode, increasing number of facts available in Campaign to 700. Have fun, and if you have enjoyed the Expansion Pack, please leave a review on it.

One more thing - a new video by Jack Septic Eye:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dv2Pf3ESztU
That's it for now. Hope you all have a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: 50,000 players!
notes.content:
Congratulations to everyone!

It's important milestone to me, since it means the game is interesting to people. It has around hundred letsplays on YouTube, including one by Draegast with over 40 000 views [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LMnSdJ2_-lE][link][/url]. I wasn't expecting less from you, and it is happy to see you loved True or False!

In the meantime, I'm working on the upcoming free DLC, and it will contain plenty of surprises! Hopefully, most of you will check it out.

Rock on!

notes.title: Campaign mode to the resque!
notes.content:
Hello all,

You're amazing. It was you who made hundreds of screenshots with hillarious captions, and hundreds of funny letsplays. 

I saw you having fun, so everything else just doesn't matter.

Today with the new update I want to address one of the frequent issues  players had recenty.

Now there is a new game mode called "Campaign". It will let you see 200 consecutive questions without having to repeat questions. It will also save your progress if you'll decide to stop and continue your journey later. 

I'm hoping this will make your playthroughs much more comfortable, and hopefully everyone will get missing achievements they spent so much time hunting for.

From now on, I'm working on the upcoming free DLC, and I'm already so excited about it (still won't reveal anything today).

Hope you all have a fantastic week!

notes.title: True or False is out now!
notes.content:
Hello all,

We worked hard to do our best, and we hope you'll have fun playing the game! 

The game was made for any curious people out there, so I'm glad that it is possible for players from China, Russia and South Korea to enjoy it in their native languages. Translators did an amazing work, and I want to thank everyone who helped out with the game! 

If you have enjoyed the game, please remember to leave a review and share the game with your friends and family. Unfortunately, Valve can't protect indie developers against review bombing and trolls - so your support is very important. Depending on the players' reception of the game, there might be several more free content updates.

Next week I'm starting to work on "Silver September" Free-LC, so all the players will be handed at least one free DLC. "Silver September" is scheduled to launch by the end of September and will include up to 100 additional facts. You can read more about post-release plans in the previous announcement.

By the way, you are more than welcome to stream videos and upload game-related content, and of course you are free to monetize videos.

That's it for now. Hope you all have a fantastic weekend, see you again at the end of September!

notes.title: True or False Launches September 16th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26098736/59aa82ccd193d09edec44a0b19fdc0ea6c7ac137.jpg[/img]

Hello all, 

Thank you for the patience! 

True or False is scheduled to launch on [b]September 16, 2016[/b], so I thought we’d take a look at the post-release content plans for the game.

In the months following launch, all the players will be handed at least one free DLC:
[list]
[*] Silver September DLC, which is scheduled to launch by the end of September and will include up to 100 additional facts.
[/list]
Depending on the players' reception of the game, there might be several more free content updates:
[list]
[*] October DLC, which will include additional facts available to all players;
[*] November DLC, which will include additional facts available to all players;
[*] Expansion Pack's Update, which will include more exclusive facts available to Expansion Pack's owners.
[/list]
But that's not all! 

There is a growing interest in adding even more facts among the game's followers. Starting today, I'm accepting your own facts on Steam Discussions. When there would be enough facts collected, they would be released as a free DLC available to all of the players by the end of the autumn.

That's it for now. Hope you all have a fantastic week!
